description: Queensland Crime Maps and Statistics is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Queensland Police Service. The Queensland Police Service provides data on crime statistics through three main formats: An interactive crime map, annual reports as downloadable PDF documents, and downloadable CSV datasets. The interactive crime map provides information on the types of crimes that happened in Queensland over the past two years. Statistics are available for a range of regions including Local Government Areas (LGAs) and suburbs. Coverage is the states and territories, 2001 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
